title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCoNatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilitiesThe Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include:Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline managementMap priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation.Eligibility, due diligence & agreementsCoordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentationLead closure of contract signatures.Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system(land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).Reforestation delivery enablementTranslate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress).Stakeholder engagement and safeguardsPlan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism.Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required.ReportingLead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders.Teamwork and cultureSupport the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributesTo perform successfully in this role, you will have:A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skillsExcellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partnersAbility to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.LocationRemote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructionsEmail CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery ManagerSubmission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Data Operations Analyst
description: About Us:YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:- Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes- Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months- Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure- Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intentionIf your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you’re hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.About The Role:The Data Operations Analyst plays a critical role in transforming messy, raw product data into high-quality metrics that our retail and brand customers rely on to analyze performance and make decisions. The core of this role is applying strong judgment to shape imperfect data into consistent, scalable, and analytically meaningful outputs.Each customer has unique business questions, data structures, and definitions of success. The Data Operations Analyst works closely with internal teams to interpret these needs, resolve ambiguity in the underlying data, and design solutions that balance accuracy, scalability, and customer expectations. This role requires strong analytical thinking, comfort working with incomplete or inconsistent data, and accountability for delivering reliable metrics at scale.As Our Data Operations Analyst, You Will:- Transform raw, messy product and transaction data into structured, customer-ready metrics.- Apply judgment to resolve ambiguity in data, including handling incomplete, incorrect, or inconsistent inputs.- Define and implement rules and logic that make data analytically meaningful and comparable over time.- Build and maintain mappings, benchmarks, and normalization approaches that allow customer data to be analyzed at scale.- Execute product categorization and attribution when needed as part of broader metric-building workflows.- Identify data quality issues and determine appropriate tradeoffs when perfect data is not available.- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to plan and deliver data projects on time and with high accuracy.- Ensure consistency and reliability of outputs across customers while accounting for customer-specific nuances.- Continuously improve processes and workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and scalability.- Take ownership of deliverables and be accountable for the quality and usability of the final data.You Are Likely To Succeed If You Have…- 1–3 years of experience working in a data-focused role such as data operations, analytics, research, or data quality.- Strong analytical judgment and comfort making decisions in ambiguous or imperfect data environments.- Experience turning raw data into structured outputs, metrics, or analyses that others rely on.- The ability to reason through edge cases, inconsistencies, and tradeoffs in real-world data.- High attention to detail paired with an understanding of how data decisions impact downstream analysis.- Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.- The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities while maintaining accuracy and accountability.- Clear communication skills, including the ability to explain data assumptions and decisions to internal stakeholders.- Experience using SQL, Python, or similar tools for data exploration, validation, or automation.- Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher).Technical Skills (Helpful but Not Required):- Comfort working with large datasets using spreadsheets, internal tools, or data platforms.- Familiarity with data transformation, data quality checks, or analytics workflows.- Exposure to product, retail, or consumer data is a plus.What We Offer:- Our compensation package includes competitive salary and comprehensive benefit offerings.- Opportunities to build a career as a manager or individual contributor through our career ladder that promotes based on impact. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets. Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a ‘can-do’ attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines. Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Arquiteto De Software
description: A VMetrix é uma empresa SaaS que desenvolve uma plataforma financeira integral utilizada por bancos, fundos de pensão, gestoras de fundos, corretoras e asset managers no Chile e na América Latina. Nossa plataforma cobre o ciclo completo de gestão de investimentos: desde a captura de operações e gestão do ciclo de vida transacional, até a precificação, contabilidade, risco de mercado, compliance regulatório e reporting. Propósito do Cargo Arquiteto de Software é responsável por definir, evoluir e governar a arquitetura técnica da plataforma VMetrix. Este papel atua como ponte entre os requisitos de negócio financeiro, as restrições regulatórias e a implementação técnica, garantindo que as decisões arquiteturais suportem a escalabilidade, manutenibilidade e compliance da plataforma a longo prazo. Lidera o design dos sistemas mais complexos, estabelece os padrões técnicos para toda a equipe de desenvolvimento e governa a adoção estratégica de ferramentas de IA no ciclo de engenharia. Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento e Manutenção da Plataforma Desenvolver e manter módulos core da plataforma: ciclo de vida transacional (captura, validação, aprovação, liquidação), precificação de instrumentos, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado e reporting regulatório. Implementar lógica de negócio financeiro complexa: processos de precificação mark-to-market, cálculos de P&L, accruals, amortizações, simulações end-of-day e processos batch de fechamento. Escrever código bem estruturado, eficiente, testável e aderente aos padrões arquiteturais definidos pela equipe de Arquitetura. Identificar bugs, gargalos e oportunidades de melhoria na base de código, propondo e implementando soluções com foco em qualidade e manutenibilidade. Antecipar necessidades futuras do sistema, sendo proativo na identificação de riscos técnicos e propondo soluções antes que se tornem impedimentos. Arquitetura de Dados e PL/SQL Projetar e otimizar procedures PL/SQL em Oracle 21c, incluindo pipelined functions, estratégias com Global Temporary Tables e packages de cálculo financeiro. Construir APIs REST robustas para integração com sistemas externos (ERPs, sistemas contábeis, provedores de dados de mercado), cobrindo múltiplas classes de ativos. Participar no design de motores genéricos com arquitetura metadata-driven, múltiplas estratégias de execução e cache de alto desempenho. Qualidade, Testes e Revisão de Código Analisar, depurar e testar software de forma sistemática, garantindo conformidade com as especificações técnicas definidas. Realizar revisões de código com foco em qualidade, segurança, performance e aderência aos padrões arquiteturais da plataforma. Definir e aplicar estratégias de testes (unitários, integração, contrato) em colaboração com o time de Arquitetura. Garantir que os módulos desenvolvidos sejam seguros, estáveis e aderentes às exigências regulatórias dos mercados atendidos. Colaboração Técnica e Mentoria Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com o Arquiteto de Software e Tech Leads para o cumprimento das diretrizes técnicas e das demandas da área. Realizar mentoria técnica de desenvolvedores juniores e plenos: revisões de design, pair programming e transferência de conhecimento do domínio financeiro. Participar ativamente de reuniões técnicas de equipe para discussão e alinhamento de demandas, soluções e prioridades. Monitorar tendências e tecnologias, contribuindo com propostas de melhoria de processos e ferramentas utilizadas no desenvolvimento dos produtos da empresa. Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Utilizar ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) de forma produtiva e responsável no ciclo diário de desenvolvimento: geração de código, revisão, debugging e escrita de testes. Elaborar e consumir especificações técnicas otimizadas para uso com LLMs, garantindo que a documentação sirva tanto para a equipe quanto como contexto de alta qualidade para ferramentas de IA generativa. Aplicar engenharia de prompts no contexto de desenvolvimento: formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Requisitos Técnicos: Formação acadêmica: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas. Pós-graduação ou certificações técnicas relevantes são diferenciais. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento de software. Domínio avançado de Java 8+ e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, transações, testes). Experiência sólida em Oracle Database (PL/SQL, pipelined functions, partitioning, performance tuning, schemas complexos). Conhecimento prático de Kubernetes (OKE) e deployments em containers (Docker, WebLogic em OKE). Experiência com padrões de arquitetura: metadata-driven designs, cache distribuído (Caffeine/Redis), event-driven, repository pattern. Familiaridade com ferramentas de desenvolvimento modernas: Git e Git Flow, pipelines CI/CD, Postman/OpenAPI. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA: Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot ou similares — incluindo uso em geração de código, escrita de testes, refatoração e debugging. Capacidade de engenharia de prompts aplicada ao desenvolvimento: saber formular contextos precisos, decompor problemas e validar criticamente as saídas de modelos de linguagem. Capacidade de ler e produzir especificações técnicas detalhadas em formato Markdown. Requisitos Desejáveis: Conhecimento do domínio financeiro: renda fixa, renda variável, derivativos, fundos de investimento, gestão de portfólios, contabilidade de investimentos, risco de mercado. Experiência com regulação financeira brasileira ou latino-americana (CVM, BACEN, ANBIMA, ou órgãos equivalentes). Experiência com integrações Office (Excel Add-ins) para plataformas SaaS financeiras. Familiaridade com padrões da indústria financeira (FpML, ISDA, ou outros). Experiência com observabilidade: Grafana, métricas de aplicação, alerting. Conhecimento de práticas GitOps e versionamento de infraestrutura como código (IaC). Familiaridade com testes de contrato (contract testing) e testes de integração em arquiteturas de microsserviços. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações equivalentes em tecnologias do stack. Pós-graduação ou MBA em áreas de tecnologia, engenharia ou gestão de inovação. Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura: Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico: Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão: Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não. Por que trabalhar na VMetrix Na VMetrix, não buscamos “fazer mais barulho”, mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, a VMetrix é o lugar.

title: Remote Video Data Annotators - 74491
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L. Role Overview: We are looking for highly detail-oriented Video Data Annotators to support cutting-edge AI/ML initiatives focused on first-person (egocentric) video understanding. In this role, you will analyze video clips and answer questions based strictly on what is visually observable at a specific moment in time. Your work will directly contribute to training and improving advanced vision-language models. This is a precision-driven role that requires strong observational skills, disciplined thinking, and the ability to follow strict guidelines. Key Responsibilities: Review first-person video clips and analyze visual content at specific timestamps Provide accurate, concise, and evidence-based answers grounded in visible information Identify and select the exact visual evidence supporting each answer Determine whether a question is valid or unanswerable based on the available video content Ensure no use of future frames or external assumptions when answering questions Maintain high consistency and accuracy across large volumes of tasks Adhere strictly to project guidelines, formatting, and quality standards Perform self-review to ensure alignment between question, evidence, and answer Required Skills and Qualifications: Core Skills Strong attention to detail and ability to spot subtle visual differences Excellent observational and visual interpretation skills Clear and concise written communication Strong reading comprehension and understanding of nuanced questions Critical thinking and logical reasoning (sequence, counting, spatial awareness) Ability to remain objective and avoid assumptions beyond visible data Behavioral Traits High level of focus and consistency in repetitive, detail-heavy tasks Strong ownership and accountability for quality of work Ability to follow strict guidelines with high precision Self-driven with a proactive quality-check mindset Preferred Backgrounds: Experience in data annotation, data labeling, or content moderation Exposure to image/video annotation or computer vision projects Background in QA, quality assurance, or analytical roles Familiarity with AI/ML data workflows is a plus Offer Details: Commitments Required : 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 4 weeks;
(expected start date isnext week) Evaluation Process: Candidates will need to complete an assessment, after which the team will reach out with the next steps. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Jr Partnerships Specialist
description: We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals. The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded. Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today. Responsibilities Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value Meet and exceed monthly goals Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless Required Experience Excellent English communication skills 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success! Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent Desired Experience Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales Additional Information Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big! You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions Work with smart and creative people Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent! We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you! Start: ASAP About Velozient We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Tech Lead Ruby On Rails
description:
Grupo Smart Fit, a força que ativa o seu potencial. O Grupo Smart Fit é a maior plataforma de fitness e bem-estar da América Latina e um dos grupos que mais crescem no mundo. Com atuação em mais de 16 países, mais de 2.000 unidades, mais de 23 mil colaboradores e um ecossistema completo de marcas, impactamos milhões de pessoas todos os dias por meio de experiências que promovem saúde, movimento e qualidade de vida. Aqui, fazer parte do time é crescer junto. Buscamos pessoas que queiram treinar para evoluir sempre, assumir protagonismo na carreira e construir uma trajetória sólida dentro de um grupo forte, em constante expansão e movimento. Trabalhar no Grupo Smart Fit é levar na carreira a força de um grande grupo global, com visão de longo prazo, estrutura robusta e oportunidades reais de crescimento, mobilidade entre marcas e novos desafios ao longo da jornada. Tudo isso em uma cultura de alta performance, forte, colaborativa e conectada ao nosso propósito. Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Operations Director
description: Kinetic Homes - Operations Director Introduction: Kinetic Homes is a homebuilder based in Jacksonville FL focused on expanding homeownership by constructing high quality, affordable homes in vibrant neighborhoods. The business was founded by Erik Nordahl and has built & sold over 100 homes over the past 3 years. This role will be an early hire in a rapidly growing organization. The individual for this role will report directly to the founder, Erik Nordahl. Mentorship and professional development are critical to Erik, and he will seek to assist his colleagues in their professional development and share the learnings he has accumulated throughout his career. This individual will have opportunity to eventually manage a team of individual contributors in the future. Compensation: $40,000-90,000 USD per year. Duties & Responsibilities: Permitting Ensure all necessary permits are obtained for new construction projects. Complete and submit permit applications for new construction. Assist with septic permits and HOA applications. Address permit application rejections in a timely manner. Facilitate communication between surveyors, architects, engineers, etc. via email and phone. Regularly call and email vendors and city officials to ensure timely deliverables. Maintain database to ensure files are updated with all necessary documentation. Maintain a knowledge of and be prepared to answer questions about the status of permits for all new construction. Development Support Prepare permit packages to be sent to our field development team. File required documentation through online portals to be recorded with the appropriate county. Procurement Regularly solicit updated pricing among vendors to ensure we are obtaining competitive pricing. Request purchase orders for active jobs that are under construction. Check invoices from vendors to ensure that invoiced amounts match master pricing agreements. Transaction Support Prepare drafts of Purchase & Sale contracts. Assist team in due diligence process coordination for all transactions. Maintain closing calendars for transactions to ensure team is aware of key deadlines and terms. Qualifications: University degree. Four or more years of successful experience in a professional work environment Strong skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel) and Adobe PDF. Interest and use of latest AI technology products is key. Interest and curiosity in how to streamline operations through AI and technology is viewed positively. Possess strong verbal and written English skills. Must be highly organized and attentive to detail. Willing to work in high-pressure environment. Willing to be responsive and communicative. Availability is key. Candidate must be willing to respond to time-sensitive requests outside of normal working hours. Normal working hours are 9AM to 5PM EST. The team member may occasionally be asked to work weekends, but that is abnormal. Good attitude necessary.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Analista De Aplicações Web E Produtos Digitais - Po
description: A Airswift está com uma nova oportunidade para Product Owner, para atuar em um cliente global do setor de energia, em aplicações utilizadas por times de negócios em diferentes regiões do mundo. Sobre a posição O profissional será responsável por apoiar a transição e sustentação de duas aplicações. Essas aplicações estão em um plano de descontinuação e, portanto, o foco da posição será: Suporte operacional Manutenção Estabilidade das aplicações Apoio à transição para futuras soluções que irão substituí-las Não haverá desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades. Responsabilidades Criar user stories e critérios de aceite claros e completos. Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado à visão do produto e ao roadmap. Trabalhar em conjunto com o Delivery Team e o Scrum Master no planejamento e execução. Atuar como a voz do cliente, entendendo continuamente as necessidades do negócio. Interagir com usuários para análise de demandas e alinhamento de expectativas. Apoiar o Program Team em roadmap e planos de release. Colaborar com outros Product Owners para gerenciamento de dependências. Proteger o time de interrupções fora de escopo durante os sprints. Criar e gerenciar tickets de atendimento para clientes finais. Requisitos Experiência como Product Owner Vivência com metodologias ágeis. Inglês avançado/fluente – todas as interações serão realizadas em inglês. Forte capacidade de: Entendimento do negócio Comunicação clara Experiência ou familiaridade com: Zendesk Amazon Connect Sistemas internos / soluções customizadas (diferencial) Modelo de trabalho Híbrido, caso profissional seja de Curitiba (diferencial) ou Remoto Horário: 8h às 17h Início: previsão final de Março 2026

title: Ai Agent Development & Delivery Manager-Brazil
description: AI Agent Builder Job Core Responsibilities Agent Construction & Workflow Setup: Use low-code platforms (e.G., Coze, n8n, Dify) to build and debug Chatflows. You will be responsible for setting up the logic branches, slot filling, and task-oriented closed loops. Prompt Engineering & Tuning: Write and refine high-quality System Prompts to control AI behavior, persona, and task accuracy. Continuously optimize prompts based on real-world interaction data. System Integration & Debugging: Support the integration of AI Agents with client systems (CRM, Helpdesk, etc.) via APIs and Webhooks. Use basic coding (Python/JS) to handle data parsing and custom logic nodes. Local Scripting & Voice Strategy: Translate and adapt AI scripts to fit local linguistic nuances. Define voice strategies—including tone, speed, and emphasis, to ensure a natural, human-like voice experience. QA & Daily Operations: Monitor AI performance, identify\ "Bad Cases,\" and perform troubleshooting. Conduct pre-launch testing (UAT) to ensure the agent meets quality standards before deployment. Global Collaboration: Communicate with international clients and cross-functional teams (R&D, Sales) to deconstruct requirements and deliver localized solutions. AI Agent Builder Core Qualifications Language: Fluent in English (Spoken & Written). You can confidently lead technical meetings and write high-quality, professional prompts/documentation. Logical Thinking: Strong ability to deconstruct complex business needs into clear, step-by-step logic flows. Technical Foundation: Basic Python/JS skills (must know how to parse JSON and handle API/Webhook data). Conceptual understanding of LLMs and a strong intuition for Prompt Engineering. Fast Learner: Ability to quickly master new Agent Builder/Workflow tools (e.G., Coze, n8n) and thrive in a fast-paced environment.

title: Snowflake Developer
description: Job Title: Snowflake Engineer Location: Remote Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Snowflake Engineer with strong expertise in cloud data warehousing and ETL/ELT pipeline development. title: Analista De Aplicações Web E Produtos Digitais - Po
description: A Airswift está com uma nova oportunidade para Product Owner, para atuar em um cliente global do setor de energia, em aplicações utilizadas por times de negócios em diferentes regiões do mundo. Sobre a posição O profissional será responsável por apoiar a transição e sustentação de duas aplicações. Essas aplicações estão em um plano de descontinuação e, portanto, o foco da posição será: Suporte operacional Manutenção Estabilidade das aplicações Apoio à transição para futuras soluções que irão substituí-las Não haverá desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades. Responsabilidades Criar user stories e critérios de aceite claros e completos. Priorizar e manter o backlog alinhado à visão do produto e ao roadmap. Participar de cerimônias ágeis, apoiando o time na entrega. Colaborar com arquitetos e times técnicos na definição de demandas técnicas e de infraestrutura. Balancear entregas, dívida técnica e melhorias necessárias. Garantir que as entregas gerem valor real ao negócio. Trabalhar em conjunto com o Delivery Team e o Scrum Master no planejamento e execução. Atuar como a voz do cliente, entendendo continuamente as necessidades do negócio. Interagir com usuários para análise de demandas e alinhamento de expectativas. Apoiar o Program Team em roadmap e planos de release. Colaborar com outros Product Owners para gerenciamento de dependências. Proteger o time de interrupções fora de escopo durante os sprints. Criar e gerenciar tickets de atendimento para clientes finais. Requisitos Experiência como Product Owner Vivência com metodologias ágeis. Inglês avançado/fluente – todas as interações serão realizadas em inglês. Forte capacidade de: Entendimento do negócio Comunicação clara Experiência ou familiaridade com: Zendesk Amazon Connect Sistemas internos / soluções customizadas (diferencial) Modelo de trabalho Híbrido, caso profissional seja de Curitiba (diferencial) ou Remoto Horário: 8h às 17h Início: previsão final de Março 2026

title: Marketing Coordinator
description: Are you ready to launch your marketing career to the next level? At Qencode, we’re not just at the cutting edge of video technology, we’re redefining it! We partner with Fortune 500 companies like NVIDIA, AWS, and Google to power the future of video. From Per-Title Encoding AI to Speech-to-Text and subtitles, we’re shipping innovations that change how the world experiences video. We’re looking for a Marketing Coordinator who’s eager to learn quickly and gain broad, hands-on experience across marketing. In this role, you’ll support senior leadership while executing a wide range of activities — from email and social to website updates, HubSpot campaigns and more. It’s an ideal opportunity for someone who wants to grow their skills fast, wear multiple hats, and learn how marketing works end-to-end in a dynamic startup environment. Your Goals Build and launch email campaigns in HubSpot (newsletters, product updates, nurture sequences). Manage and schedule social media content across LinkedIn, X, and other channels. Update and maintain website content (landing pages, blog posts, product pages). Support campaign execution for product launches, webinars, events, and content rollouts. Coordinate content and creative assets with internal stakeholders and external partners. Qualifications 2–4 years of marketing experience (internships and agency roles count). Familiarity with marketing automation tools (ie: HubSpot). Detail-oriented and organized, with the ability to juggle multiple priorities. Curiosity and a growth mindset, quick learner who wants to expand your skills. Comfortable working in a fast-moving, startup environment. Benefits Learn from experienced leaders. Work directly with the founding team. Join an environment of innovation where new ideas are encouraged and rewarded. Be part of something big. Help shape how the next generation of developers build with video. Room to grow. As Qencode grows, so will your role and career path. 100% Remote position working with a global team. Professional development and career growth opportunities including an education credit. About Us Qencode is on a mission to develop cloud video APIs that democratize the latest video technology for developers around the world. Our platform combines transcoding, live streaming, storage, and global delivery in one unified API, leveraging the latest breakthroughs in artificial intelligence and video processing. A trusted technology partner to the most demanding companies (including NVIDIA, AWS, Google, and DigitalOcean), Qencode serves clients ranging from high growth startups to Fortune 500 around the world. We have several unique features, like machine-learning powered Per-Title Encoding which reduces file sizes 60% without quality loss, while supporting popular formats like HLS, MPEG-DASH, MP4 and WebM. With flexible customization and competitive pricing, we’re built for enterprise-scale deployment across any workflow. Founded in 2017, Qencode is headquartered in Los Angeles, CA.

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap. Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website’s back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope. What We’re Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience. Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You’ll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

title: Global Networks Leader
description: Purpose As the Global Network Operations Leader, you will oversee the comprehensive management and direction of our network operations, ensuring optimal performance and reliability on a global scale. This critical role involves managing a managed service partner to deliver superior network operations and support services. Main Responsibilities Oversee the day-to-day network operations, including monitoring, maintenance, and incident response, to ensure high availability and performance. Oversee the escalation process, ensuring timely resolution of critical network issues and minimizing impact on business operations. Supervise routine maintenance activities, ensuring they are conducted efficiently and effectively to prevent unplanned downtime and extend the life of network assets. Lead change management processes for network operations, including planning, approval, and implementation of network changes to ensure minimal disruption and adherence to best practices. Act as the primary liaison with our managed service partner, ensuring they meet or exceed service level agreements (SLAs) and key performance indicators (KPIs). Continuously assess and improve network performance, reliability, and security, leveraging data and analytics to drive decision-making. Innovation and Improvement: Identify opportunities for process improvements and technology enhancements, leading initiatives to implement innovative solutions. Develop and implement risk management strategies to mitigate potential network disruptions and ensure business continuity. Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, providing regular updates on network performance, issues, and improvements. Ensure compliance with relevant Orbia infrastructure standards, regulations, and security protocols to protect the organization's network infrastructure. Take care of regular audits. Knowledge and experience requiered Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field Language(s) and level of proficiency: English (fluent) and Spanish In-depth knowledge of network infrastructure technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, load balancers, and network monitoring tools. Proficiency in network protocols, such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, BGP, OSPF, and MPLS. Experience with network security best practices and technologies, including VPNs, IDS/IPS, and network access control. Familiarity with cloud networking and hybrid cloud environments, including AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud Platform. Experience with deploying, configuring, and testing network equipment. Familiarity with automation tools and scripting (e.G., Ansible, Python). Management & communication Skills Experience in managing relationships with MSP, vendors and suppliers. Ability to communicate effectively with internal stakeholders (e.G., operations, finance, senior management). Relevant Experience Minimum of 10 years of experience in network operations management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role overseeing global network operations. Extensive experience working with and managing relationships with managed service partners. Relevant certifications such as CCNP, CCIE, or equivalent are highly desirable. ITIL certification is a plus.

title: Tech Lead Ruby On Rails
description:

Nosso ecossistema reúne marcas que atuam em diferentes frentes do fitness e bem-estar: academias como Smart Fit, Bio Ritmo e Nation CT;
studios como Race Bootcamp, Vidya Studio, Jab House, Tonus Gym, Aera Pilates, Velocity e Kore;
e produtos digitais, TotalPass e Queima Diária. Principais responsabilidades: 1. Liderança Técnica e Arquitetura Guardião da Base de Código: Definir e zelar pelos padrões de código (\ "The Rails Way\"), garantindoque a API seja sólida para os projetos Web e Mobile. Tomada de Decisão Técnica: Escolher as melhores tecnologias, bibliotecas e padrões que equilibrem rapidez de entrega com sustentabilidade futura. Apoio à Gestão: Ser o braço direito do Gerente de TI e do GP, ajudando na estimativa de prazos, viabilidade de features e priorização técnica do backlog. 2. Qualidade, Integração e Homologação Garantia de Eficiência no Processo: Homologar as integrações da API com os times de Front-end (Web e Mobile), garantindo que os contratos de dados sejam cumpridos e a performance seja máxima. Revisão de Código (Code Review): Liderar as revisões de código dos parceiros, assegurando que nenhum débito técnico crítico entre em produção. Estratégia de Testes: Definir a política de cobertura de testes e garantir que o time utilize mocks e ferramentas como VCR para manter a agilidade no desenvolvimento. 3. Sustentação, Suporte e Performance Atendimento de Chamados Nível 3: Atuar como ponto focal em problemas complexos de produção, realizando a análise de causa raiz e orientando o time na correção definitiva. Otimização Contínua: Monitorar gargalos de performance no servidor e no banco de dados, implementando melhorias proativas para suportar o crescimento do app. 4. Aprendizado e Melhoria Contínua Radar Tecnológico: Manter o time atualizado com as novas versões do Ruby e do Rails, avaliando quando migrar ou adotar novas práticas. Cultura de Inovação Pragmática: Estimular o uso de ferramentas de IA para ganho de produtividade, sem abrir mão da segurança e da qualidade do código. O que buscamos Pessoas que: Dominem Arquitetura de Sistemas com Ruby on Rails: Domínio profundo de Rails em modo API e Monolitos, com habilidade para desenhar arquiteturas escaláveis, modulares e de fácil manutenção. Têm experiência com Design de APIs e Contratos: Expertise em arquitetura RESTful, versionamento e, principalmente, na definição de contratos de dados que atendam de forma eficiente Web e Mobile. Têm experiência com Engenharia de Testes Avançada: Domínio total de RSpec, incluindo estratégias complexas de mocking com VCR e WebMock, garantindo pipelines de CI/CD rápidos e determinísticos. Têm experiência com Modelagem e Performance de Dados: Maestria em PostgreSQL, otimização de queries, gestão de índices e estratégias de cache (Redis) para suportar aplicações de alta performance. Têm experiência com Segurança e Infraestrutura: Conhecimento sólido em protocolos de segurança (OAuth2, JWT), além de familiaridade com Docker e ambientes de deploy (AWS/Heroku/DigitalOcean). Adotem estrategicamente a IA: Capacidade de liderar o time no uso eficiente de ferramentas como GitHub Copilot ou Cursor para acelerar a geração de código, testes e documentação. Tenham pragmatismo e visão de Negócio: Foco em entregar a melhor solução técnica que respeite os prazos e objetivos da empresa, evitando\ "overengineering\". Tenham Liderança e Mentoria: Capacidade de elevar o nível técnico dos devs Plenos e Juniores através de Code Reviews educativos e suporte constante. Tenham Comunicação Estratégica e Proativa: Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócio (GP) em tarefas técnicas e alinhar expectativas com os times de Front/Mobile para evitar bloqueios. Têm experiência com Gestão de Crises e Decisão: Calma e assertividade para tomar decisões técnicas difíceis sob pressão e resolver incidentes críticos em produção. Tenham Atitude de Dono: Comprometimento total com a qualidade do produto final, antecipando gargalos e propondo melhorias antes que se tornem problemas.

title: Account Manager
description: Hey, Dingus! Yep, you read that right. Dingus & Zazzy is expanding, and we're on the hunt for a sharp, people-first Account Manager who can build lasting client relationships, keep projects moving, and make sure every client feels informed, supported, and confident every step of the way. About Us Dingus & Zazzy is a global digital marketing agency helping brands grow across every corner of the digital landscape. We offer an\ "unlimited get-shit-done\" subscription for our clients, from websites to social to SEO and everything in between. Our team is full of creatives, strategists, tech geeks, and builders who love making brands look, feel, and perform better online. If that sounds like your vibe, keep reading. What You'll Do Serve as the primary point of contact for clients, managing relationships, setting expectations, and delivering excellent service at every touchpoint. Translate client marketing goals into clear, actionable tasks, and coordinate with the Marketing Coordinator for execution. Lead regular client meetings, share updates and deliverables, and ensure everything stays aligned with client expectations. Use Jiminny to document meetings, capture key takeaways, and package notes, action items, and recordings using our meeting template. Review final deliverables before submission to ensure quality, relevance, and client readiness. Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and industry contacts to strengthen collaboration and drive long-term success. Handle client concerns and dynamics with professionalism, composure, and emotional intelligence. What You Bring 2+ years of experience in account management, client services, or a similar client-facing role. Clear, confident communication skills, you can manage expectations, present deliverables, and handle tough conversations without breaking a sweat. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple clients, meetings, and deadlines simultaneously. A strategic mindset, you connect client goals to the bigger picture and collaborate with senior team members to get there. High emotional intelligence, you read the room, stay composed under pressure, and build trust naturally. Proficiency using AI tools such as Claude and Gemini to improve workflows, streamline communication, and enhance overall efficiency. Copywriting experience, you can craft clear, on-brand messaging and support content needs when required. Experience in a digital agency or marketing environment is a strong plus. Ability to work independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment. Bonus Points Familiarity with project management or CRM tools. Experience presenting creative or marketing work to clients. Background in digital marketing, understanding what your team is building makes you a better advocate for your clients. Work Details Hours: 9 A.M. – 5 P.M. MST, Monday to Friday Reports to the Director of Accounts Requires a working level of written and spoken English If you're someone who genuinely loves building relationships, thrives on keeping things organized and on track, and takes pride in making clients feel like they're in the best hands, we want to hear from you. Ready for the ride of your life? Apply now!

title: Cloud Ai/Ml Engineer
description:
Looking for an experienced Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer to lead the automation of complex financial workflows at Prosigliere. Description We are seeking a Senior Cloud AI/ML Engineer with a\ "cloud-first\" mindset to join our growing team. In this role, you won't just build models;
you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services. The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions. Responsibilities Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions. Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data. Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making. Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements. Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations. Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow. Technology Requirements 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations. Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.). Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors. Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows. Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components. Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments. Profile Requirements Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap. Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist. Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders. Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments. AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better. Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Analista De Negócios Em Rh
description:
O Grupo Fleury é uma das maiores e mais respeitadas instituições de medicina e saúde do Brasil. Referência por sua excelência técnica, médica e de atendimento, é também destaque nas melhores práticas ESG. Além dos serviços de medicina diagnóstica, o Grupo Fleury conta com uma oferta crescente de serviços que buscam responder às necessidades das pessoas, além de gerar sustentabilidade para o sistema de saúde com a melhor utilização dos recursos investidos. Essas soluções refletem o posicionamento estratégico da empresa de ser um ecossistema de saúde integrada, preventiva e híbrida, combinando ofertas físicas e digitais. Acreditamos que carreira e propósito caminham juntos, e costumamos falar que somos apaixonados pelas pessoas e pelo que fazemos. Isso reflete em nosso dia a dia, por meio de um trabalho que impacta vidas. Faz parte da nossa essência cuidar das pessoas, colocando as colaboradoras, colaboradores, médicas, médicos e clientes sempre no centro. Se você tem atitude positiva, empatia, adaptabilidade e deseja se desenvolver em um ambiente repleto de profissionais referências no mercado que prezam por respeito, excelência e inovação, abrace a oportunidade de levar saúde e bem-estar para a plena realização das pessoas! Venha transformar sua paixão em carreira! Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo: Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas. Garantir a proteção e a disponibilidade das informações corporativas por meio de políticas robustas de segurança, mitigando riscos e assegurando a continuidade do negócio. Atuar de forma estratégica em projetos, integrando a segurança desde a concepção e fortalecendo a cultura organizacional. Promover a conscientização dos colaboradores, acompanhar tendências e aplicar soluções inovadoras para manter a conformidade e a resiliência digital. Além disso, liderar a gestão eficiente de recursos, negociar com parceiros e desenvolver uma equipe de alta performance, orientada a resultados e inovação contínua. Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente! Principais atividades: Liderança estratégica: Coordenação da área de Segurança da Informação, garantindo proteção, continuidade e integridade dos serviços de TI em toda a organização. Gestão de ambiente complexo: Proteção de milhares de usuários, ativos, sistemas, sites e operações críticas 24x7, incluindo unidades e parceiros. Segurança de parceiros: Garantia de acessos seguros e operação contínua para laboratórios e stakeholders externos. Planejamento estratégico: Definição e implementação da estratégia de segurança da informação, alinhada ao negócio e às melhores práticas de mercado (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS). Governança e compliance: Estruturação de políticas, processos e comitês executivos, assegurando conformidade, auditorias e evolução da maturidade em segurança. Gestão de identidade e acessos: Controle de acessos, credenciais, MFA, PAM e gestão de riscos em sistemas e infraestrutura. Gestão de incidentes: Monitoramento contínuo e resposta eficaz a incidentes de segurança, minimizando impactos operacionais. Gestão de vulnerabilidades: Redução de riscos por meio de atualização de patches, correção de falhas e fortalecimento da infraestrutura. Proteção de infraestrutura crítica: Administração de firewalls, acessos privilegiados e segurança perimetral. Gestão financeira: Planejamento e controle orçamentário (OPEX/CAPEX), negociação com fornecedores e otimização de investimentos. Cultura de segurança: Condução de treinamentos, campanhas de conscientização e simulações para engajamento dos colaboradores. Inovação e resiliência: Implementação de soluções modernas para antecipar ameaças e garantir conformidade regulatória. Impacto no negócio: Atuação estratégica para sustentar operações seguras e contribuir com a missão organizacional. Buscamos alguém que apresente: Formação: Superior em áreas relacionadas à Engenharia, Tecnologia da Informação, Segurança da Informação ou áreas afins Certificações como CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Conhecimento em Gestão de Privacidade e Riscos Conformidade regulatória (LGPD, GDPR) Conhecimento específicos: Políticas de segurança Soluções de arquivamento de dados para segurança e auditoria, análise forense, prática de engenharia social. Gestão direta de Red Team, Blue Team e Gestão de Acessos Campanhas de sensibilização e conscientização de segurança da informação na organização Soluções de segurança da informação tais como IPS, IDS, Firewall, criptografia, SIEM, ZTNA, MDM, ACS, Proxy, Anti-APT, WAF e demais soluções de segurança Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Informações da vaga: Modelo de Trabalho: Aberto a negociação ( Atuação poderá ser home, ou Hibrido) Carga Horária: 220h Escala: Segunda á sexta Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48 Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito. Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que: - Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;
- Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;
- Busquem consciênciasocial de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;
- Identifiquem eantecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;
- Planejem e executemo trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;
- Gerem e implementemnovas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado. Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada! Saúde e Bem-estar: - Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;
- Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;
- Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;
- Acesso à plataformaOrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;
- Licença maternidadee paternidade estendidas;
- Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida. Proteção e estabilidade: - Previdência privada;
- Participação nos lucros;
- Seguro de vida. Facilidades para o dia a dia: - Vale-Alimentação;
- Vale-Refeição;
- Vale-Transporte;
- Auxílio-Creche;
- Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços. Desenvolvimento e educação: - Plataforma de ensino;
- Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições. Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória. Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas. Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família. Para conhecer mais sobre o Grupo Fleury, acesse o site: O Grupo Fleury informa que a participação em seus processos seletivos é gratuita e nenhuma empresa terceira está autorizada a cobrar valores para a candidatura às vagas, ao treinamento, ao material didático ou qualquer outra despesa relacionada.
