title: Executivo Comercial
description:
A Knewin é a maior empresa de tecnologia e inteligência de dados da América Latina, com 15 anos de mercado, mais de 200 pessoas e presença consolidada no ecossistema de comunicação, marketing e inteligência de mercado. Desenvolvemos soluções de tecnologia que empoderam marcas, de assessorias de imprensa e agências de relações públicas a grandes empresas e governos. Somos uma empresa em forte expansão, com três rodadas de capital de risco realizadas (Oria Capital), cultura ágil e um time que acredita que tecnologia e pessoas transformam negócios de verdade. Estamos buscando um(a) Executivo(a) de Vendas para atuar no segmento Mid Market e Enterprise, com perfil híbrido : capaz de fechar novos negócios com leads gerados pelo Marketing, desenvolver prospecção ativa (outbound) e explorar oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes existente. Essa é uma vaga para quem tem mentalidade de crescimento, visão de negócio e sabe construir relações consultivas com decisores de comunicação e marketing em empresas de médio e grande porte. Vaga 100% remota - Home Office Responsabilidades e atribuições Atuar no ciclo completo de vendas: da qualificação ao fechamento, com contas Mid Market e Enterprise;
Trabalhar leads qualificados gerados pelo Marketing (inbound), com foco em conversão eficiente;
Executar prospecção outbound ativa, mapeando contas estratégicas, personalizando abordagens e gerando pipeline próprio;
Identificar e desenvolver oportunidades de Upsell e Cross-sell dentro da base de clientes atual, em parceria com o time de Customer Success;
Conduzir apresentaçõese demos consultivas das soluções Knewin, adaptando o discurso ao contexto e às dores de cada cliente;
Construir e manter relacionamento sólido com múltiplos stakeholders (comunicação, marketing, C-level);
Mapear o processo decisório do cliente e influenciar cada etapa do funil;
Manter o CRM (HubSpot)atualizado com precisão e disciplina, garantindo previsibilidade de pipeline;
Elaborar propostas comerciais personalizadas e conduzir negociações complexas;
Colaborar ativamente com Marketing, CS e RevOps para otimizar conversão e reduzir churn. Requisitos e qualificações Experiência comprovada em vendas B2B SaaS, com ciclos de venda consultivos e tickets médios/altos;
Experiência com contasMid Market ou Enterprise;
Histórico de atuação híbrida: capacidade tanto de converter inbound quanto de gerar pipeline outbound;
Experiência com vendasconsultivas;
Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com habilidade real de se comunicar com decisores;
Familiaridade com ferramentas de CRM, HubSpot é diferencial;
Ensino superior completo. Também é legal se você tiver: Vivência em ambientes de scale-up e/ou startups em crescimento acelerado ou empresas de tecnologia;
Familiaridade com HubSpot. Carteira ou relacionamento com profissionais de Comunicação e Marketing em empresas de médio/grande porte;
Experiência com ferramentas de prospecção e automação (ex: Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator);
Conhecimento do ecossistema de agências de PR e assessorias de imprensa;
O que oferecemos: Trabalho 100% remoto - Home Office;
Política de remuneração variável agressiva - com comissionamento competitivo e upside real atrelado à sua performance;
Pacote de benefícios Knewin;
Produto consolidado com cases relevantes no mercado;
Time comercialestruturado com suporte de Marketing, RevOps e CS;
Ambiente dinâmico, flexível e com autonomia real;
Oportunidade de crescimento em uma empresa em fase de expansão acelerada.

title: .Net/C - React (Fullstack)
description:
.NET/C# - React (Fullstack)BrazilSenior Software EngineerImportant Information Location: BrazilJob Mode: Full-time Work Mode: Work from home Job SummaryAs a .NET/C# and React Engineer, you will make a significant contribution to our platform's evolution by developing innovative features and ensuring its ongoing stability through close collaboration with a cross-functional team. This role is responsible for contributing to the full software development lifecycle, from concept and design to deployment and maintenance, while upholding high standards for code quality and performance. Work closely with multidisciplinary teams—including Product, QA, and UX—in agile settings to deliver resilient solutions that support strategic business objectives;
Actively participate incode reviews, technical discussions, and propose architectural improvements to optimize platform performance and reliability;
Provide technical guidance to other engineers on the team, promoting best development practices and contributing to team growth. Essential SkillsExperience with the .NET/C# ecosystem for backend development and React for frontend in cloud-based (SaaS) environments;
Strong understanding ofsoftware architecture, design patterns, and agile methodologies such as Scrum and Kanban. Highly Desirable SkillsExperience with AWS cloud platform (preferred), microservices architecture, and container technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes;
Deep knowledge of SQL and database design for both relational and non-relational systems (Postgres, MongoDB);
Familiarity with building and maintaining continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines and DevOps practices;
Knowledge or hands-on experience with the Angular framework for frontend development;
Experience withIDM (Identity Management). About EncoraEncora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

Para sustentar esse princípio, a SolutionMall também dá atenção especial à verificação de cibersegurança e aos padrões de segurança em nível de dispositivo antes que os produtos sejam incorporados às soluções de projeto. 2) Visão Geral da Função Estamos procurando um Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Negócios – Soluções de Cibersegurança para apoiar a expansão da atuação da SolutionMall no Brasil. Esta é uma função part-time, baseada em cooperação. Procuramos alguém que compreenda o valor prático da cibersegurança em sistemas reais e consiga impulsionar tanto a conscientização dos clientes quanto as oportunidades de negócio. A função combina principalmente: desenvolvimento de negócios relacionados à cibersegurança promoção de soluções e conceitos comunicação com clientes e parceiros acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto comunicação técnico-comercial básica sobre segurança cooperação no desenvolvimento de mercado de longo prazo 3) Principais Responsabilidades Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Expansão de Mercado SolutionMall na promoção de uma mentalidade mais forte de segurança em projetos nos quais a cibersegurança ainda não seja totalmente priorizada Acompanhamento de Oportunidades de Projeto Acompanhar necessidades de clientes e oportunidades de projeto relacionadas a aplicações sensíveis à segurança Ajudar a identificar em quais cenários a cibersegurança pode se tornar um fator importante na tomada de decisão do projeto Apoiar discussões de projeto em que sejam relevantes seleção segura de produtos, controle de acesso ao sistema e requisitos ligados à privacidade Auxiliar na conversão do interesse do cliente em discussões comerciais práticas e oportunidades concretas de projeto Coordenação Técnica e de Soluções Manter uma compreensão prática das expectativas básicas de cibersegurança title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

title: Analista De Automação De Processos Pleno
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.** A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays. You want something else. Something you build yourself. We have that.
--- ### Who we are Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work. The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year. Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.
--- ### The role: Founder's Associate You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week. In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different: - One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.
- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.
- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.
- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week. The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.
--- ### Your first 30 days - **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.
- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.
- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.
- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it. By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.
--- ### What you get (beyond salary) **Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration. **Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time. **Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.
--- ### Where this role can take you In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths: - **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook - **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works - **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.
--- ### Who we're looking for You: - Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation** - Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field** - Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent) - **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist. And also: - **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.
- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.
- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.
- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.
- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.
- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how. You've probably already turned down a\ "stable\" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.
--- ### The honest deal We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job. We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have. In return we give: - **Competitive PJ salary.** - **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.
--- ### This is NOT for you if - You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day - You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes - You want to be a specialist in one thing - You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet - You want an impressive title more than real impact - You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time - You expect promotions based on tenure If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.
--- ### How to apply Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question: **\ "Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage.\ "** Bespecific. We want theactual story.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all. Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo. Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners. Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery. Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position. Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia Submission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

description: So… what the hell is Ark Exotic?Ark Exotic is where founders and creatives who've already made it come to gather and access our fleet.Our members have driven everything. The novelty is gone. What they're chasing now is the social moments that they can't find anywhere else. We want to build a world of underground luxury that feel like scenes from a film.Now we're building a creative team to match and we need an AI-native performance designer who can sell the feeling of being inside Ark.What You'll Do- Design performance creatives that feel like film stills, not ads- Generate scroll-stopping visuals that pull our target deeper into the world (and the funnel)- Build on-image copy that speaks to a young successful founders- Maintain a visual language across motorsport, lifestyle, clothing, and brand storytelling pillars- Move fast — produce cinematic visuals at the volume performance marketing demandsWho You Are- We don't care about your years of experience. You're already shortlisted.- You can tell me without thinking why the Gentle Monster "Hunt" campaign works, or why a single shot of a wet parking lot at night can carry an entire brandWhat We're Building- The most-watched private world in luxury automotive. Members don't join for the cars. They join for the access, the people, and the feeling of being on the inside of something most people will never see.- This role defines what that world looks like to anyone discovering us for the first time. Welcome to Ark.

title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world's largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo's advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo's reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years' experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years. title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - JúniorA jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui. Sobre a RethinkSomos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado. Diversidade e InclusãoPara repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência.Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente? Qual será o seu papel?Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados. Como será seu dia a dia?Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial:Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento emGit e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidadepara atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se:Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio). Curtiu a oportunidade?Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

title: Pré-Vendas
description:
VAGA: SDR (Sales Development Representative ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas)Estamos em busca de SDR para atuar em escritório especializado em dívidas bancárias e reestruturação financeira, com foco em qualificação de leads, Prospecção Ativa, Qualificação Receptiva (Inbound), Gestão de Cadência e Alimentação do CRM..PRINCIPAL RESPONSABILIDADEO SDR é um pré-vendedor focado na primeira etapa do funil: pesquisar, prospectar e qualificar leads, transformando-os em oportunidades. Suas principais funções incluem investigar o perfil do lead, realizar o primeiro contato (e-mail, telefone, LinkedIn) e agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendasAS PRINCIPAIS FUNÇÕES- Prospecção Ativa (Outbound): Identificar potenciais clientes (leads) que se encaixam no perfil ideal (ICP), buscando decisores e gerando novas listas.- Qualificação de Leads (Inbound/Outbound): Analisar se o lead tem o problema que a empresa resolve, poder de decisão e verba, separando os qualificados (SQLs) dos curiosos.- Primeiro Contato e Engajamento: Realizar abordagens via WhatsApp, e-mail, ligações (cold calls) e redes sociais, utilizando fluxos de cadência para despertar interesse.- Agendamento de Reuniões: Agendar conversas entre o lead qualificado (SQLs) e os Executivos de Vendas (Closers).- Gestão de CRM: Registrar e atualizar todas as interações e informações sobre o lead no sistema de CRM.- Follow-up (Acompanhamento): Realizar contatos contínuos para manter o engajamento de leads que não estão no momento exato de compra.REQUISITOS E HABILIDADES- Resiliência e Mentalidade (Mindset): Capacidade de lidar com rejeições diárias (/"nãos/") sem perder a motivação.- Escuta Ativa: Capacidade de ouvir mais do que falar, identificando /"dores/" e nuances nas conversas com o cliente.- Conhecimento do ICP: Entender profundamente quem é o cliente ideal da empresa para filtrar e focar nos leads certos.- Personalização de Abordagem: Evitar scripts robóticos;
adaptar a conversa paracada lead de forma criativa e personalizada.- Organização e Disciplina: Manter rotina de atividades de alta demanda, boa gestão do CRM e uso correto da cadência de prospecção.- Solução de Problemas: Agilidade mental para conectar as necessidades do lead às soluções da empresa.- Curiosidade e Aprendizado Constante: Buscar conhecimento sobre o mercado, técnicas de vendas e o produto/serviço vendido.- Comunicação Persuasiva: Saber conduzir a conversa e contornar objeções com firmeza e inteligência.Diferencial:- Experiência prévia como SDR jurídico.REMUNERAÇÃO- Modelo híbrido: Ajuda de custo fixa nos três primeiros meses R$ 2.000,00 (dois mil reais), após o quarto mês R$ 2.500,00 (dois mil e quinhentos reais) + Variável por atingimento de metas;
- Comissão vinculada a reuniões agendadas com leads qualificados, contratos fechados e avaliação de atendimento;
- Comissão agressiva porindicação de leads externos as campanhas de Tráfego pago;
- Possibilidade real decrescimento financeiro e profissional.MODELO DE TRABALHO- Tipo de Contrato: PJ- PRESENCIAL NO RECIFE (BOA VIAGEM) - Inegociável!- Estrutura de SDR, playbook comercial e metas claras.Importante:1. Se os R$ 2.000,00 de ajuda de custo te parecem suficientes, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você!2. O valor fixo é esse — o diferencial está na comissão e nos prêmios por desempenho.3. Agora, se você precisa ir além, busca resultados, resolve problemas, não tem medo de prospectar e qualificar clientes e carrega mais boletos do que dias no mês, então essa oportunidade é para você.Candidate-se!

title: Sales Ai Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder Role Overview: You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows;
you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own "inboxes" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA. Key Responsibilities: - Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to "vet" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).
- Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.
- Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a "Sales Knowledge Base" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.
- CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents "write back" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention. Qualifications: - Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.
- AI Tooling: Experience with "Agent-as-a-Service" platforms (e.G., 11x, Regie.Ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.
- Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.
- Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and "reasoning loops" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Analista De Governança De Ti Sênior
description:
Purpose of the Position The Chief Technology Officer (CTO) role emerges at a pivotal moment in the company’s evolution. Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years. Main Challenges and Assignments Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.Experience and Professional Qualifications Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.G., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).Systems architecture expertise: Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.G., telecom, data centers, financial systems).Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field;
MBA or executive education is a plus.Behavioral Skills Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results;
drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively;
brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others;
adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility;
leads by example.

description: Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you! Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Who we are: Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

Following nearly three decades of history and a recent ownership transition, the organization is now balancing operational stability with technological transformation, consolidating its position as a leading SaaS platform within Brazil’s financial ecosystem. Acting as the integrator between the strategic vision of the CEOs and the execution capabilities of a technology organization spanning engineering, infrastructure, and QA, the mission is to ensure that technology and business advance in lockstep, sustaining consistent growth while maintaining excellence in uptime, delivery, and scalability.More than a technical leader, the CTO will operate as an Integrator within the EOS (Entrepreneurial Operating System) framework, enforcing rhythm, transparency, and accountability across teams. This executive will transform a technically strong but still maturing organization into a disciplined, data-driven, and performance-oriented operation, blending analytical rigor, process management, and a culture of execution in an environment transitioning from founder-led roots toward professional governance. The ideal leader combines technical depth with behavioral maturity, earning the trust of the CEOs and Board through credibility and influence rather than hierarchy. They will guide a complex technology stack, ensuring reliability and compliance in a regulated fintech environment where uptime equals reputation. Equally, this leader will act as a cultural catalyst, fostering engagement, ownership, and process discipline within a Southern Brazilian, engineering-driven culture. Success will be measured by the CTO’s ability to align entrepreneurial ambition with predictable, scalable, and autonomous execution, enabling the company to double in size within the next few years. Main Challenges and Assignments Modernize without disruption: Lead the migration from a legacy Oracle + .NET Framework platform toward. NET 7 and private cloud, maintaining near-100% uptime for regulated clients.Act as the Integrator of the EOS model: Balance the Visionary leadership of the CEOs by bringing structure, cadence, and operational accountability across teams.Professionalize the technology organization: Transform a historically founder-driven culture into a scalable, process- and data-oriented operation.Build cohesion and leadership depth: Align four technical verticals into one cohesive, high-performing structure.Sustain high performance and growth: Enable technology to support a business plan to double revenues in the next three years while maintaining profitability and quality.Influence and earn autonomy: Gain trust from leadership through credibility, technical acumen, and transparent communication.Drive engagement and culture: Foster collaboration, motivation, and a sense of ownership within the technology organization.Orchestrate transformation across stakeholders: Ensure alignment between business objectives and technical capabilities.Prepare for scale and possible M&A: Build the foundations (architecture, governance, and people) to enable future integrations and scalability.Experience and Professional Qualifications Technology leadership: Experience leading technology or engineering teams of ~50 people, ideally in SaaS, fintech, payments, or financial software environments.Transformation delivery: Proven record of leading modernization programs (e.G., replatforming, architecture redesign, or scalability initiatives).Systems architecture expertise: Deep knowledge of Microsoft technologies (.NET Framework, .NET 6/7, C#, SQL/Oracle) and infrastructure (on-premises and private cloud).Operational excellence: Background in high-uptime or mission-critical environments (e.G., telecom, data centers, financial systems).Process & governance: Experience implementing OKR/EOS or similar frameworks, ensuring cross-functional rhythm and accountability.Stakeholder management: Skilled at engaging Boards, investors, and C-levels, translating technical execution into business outcomes.Team scaling & culture: Experience recruiting, developing, and retaining top talent in growing organizations.Language: Advanced English, for interaction with an international Board environment.Education: Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field;
MBA or executive education is a plus.Behavioral Skills Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for outcomes and results;
drives initiatives to completion without requiring constant direction.Transparent & Courageous Communication – Communicates openly and constructively;
brings clarity, confidence, and respect to difficult discussions.Learning Agility & Adaptability – Displays curiosity and humility to learn from others;
adapts proven methodologies and continuously seeks better delivery methods.Executive Presence with Simplicity – Translates complex technical concepts into clear business language, operating with accessibility and pragmatism.Collaborative Influence – Builds trust and alignment across peers and teams through cooperation and credibility;
leads by example.

description: Position Overview: As the Customer Relationship Management Specialist (CRM Specialist), you will support the day-to-day execution of the CRM function. You will be a key contributor in Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC), partnering with Marketing, Operations, Contact Center, and Product to build and optimize journeys, automations, and campaigns that move clients from inquiry to booked appointment to loyal advocate. Operational Support: Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Contact Center, and Product teams to identify and help resolve friction points in the client journey. ESCOPO DE ATUAÇÃO E RESPONSABILIDADES:Design de Arquitetura Híbrida (On-premise & Cloud): Projetar e gerenciar a integração entre o legado físico e a nuvem, garantindo a integridade do dado.Governança e Modelos de Entrega: Implementar o paradigma de Data Mesh e modelos Hub-and-Spoke, provendo ambientes de Sandbox seguros e estruturas de consumo para produtos de dados.Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Definir e acompanhar métricas de saúde de infraestrutura e pipelines, garantindo visibilidade total sobre a operação.Modernização Real-Time (Stream): Implementar estratégias de ingestão em modalidade Stream e fluxos transacionais.Design de Soluções (As-Is e To-Be): Mapear o estado atual e projetar o roadmap futuro, documentando regras de negócio e pipelines.Gestão de Engenharia e Qualidade: Garantir a aplicação de modelos de Fato e Dimensão com rotinas de validação na infraestrutura.Gestão de Alta Performance: Atuar com foco em Metas e Resultados, realizando a gestão de prazos, recursos físicos e financeiros (FinOps).Definição de arquitetura de governança e virtualização de dados.Definição e implantação de ferramentas de aquisição, com construção completa de pipelines de ingestão de dados.Atuar como referência técnica, mentorando o time e disseminando conhecimento sobre as plataformas e tecnologias adotadas.Projetar e implementar soluções de dados ponta a ponta, garantindo escalabilidade, performance e segurança.Definir modelos de dados otimizados para custo e eficiência.Estabelecer modelo de orquestração e otimizar pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT) em ambientes batch e streaming. PERFIL E REQUISITOS:Formação Acadêmica: Sólida formação em Engenharia de Software, Computação ou Ciência da Computação ou cursos correlatos com especialização em Dados.Idiomas: Habilidade avançada com a língua inglesa (leitura, escrita e conversação).Comunicação Interpessoal: Habilidade para influenciar stakeholders executivos e orientar times técnicos.Domínio de Ambientes Híbridos: Experiência comprovada na integração de ambientes On-premises com soluções Cloud.Frameworks e Metodologias: Conhecimento sólido em TOGAF e experiência com modelos Hub-and-Spoke/Sandbox.Especialista em Cloud (GCP): Domínio de BigQuery, Dataflow, Cloud Composer e AlloyDB.Multi-Cloud e Bancos de Dados: Vivência com AWS, OCI e Bancos Oracle CDB/PDB, MongoDB e AlloyDB, CloudSQl, BigTable. DIFERENCIAIS:Certificações Cloud: Certificações oficiais Google Cloud (GCP Professional Data Engineer).Tecnologias Emergentes: Experiência com Denodo e uso de IA para aceleração de desenvolvimento de atividades de engenharia de dados.Desejável experiência na ferramenta Denodo.Participação na estruturação de processos. title: Cloud Systems Engineer/Devops
description:
About the ProductFor more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.Role OverviewWe are seeking an expert-level, highly skilled Cloud Systems Engineer (DevOps) to serve as a GCP Specialist and technical builder for our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable ofbuilding architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts. You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility is leading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.The ideal candidate ensures our Compute Engine environment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions.The role’s primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migrationstrategy.Key Responsibilities- Infrastructure & Networking: Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, including Cloud DNS and Cloud NAT.- Linux System Administration: Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues.- VPN Management: Build and manage secure tunnels using Cloud VPN, pfSense virtual appliances, and CloudConnexa (OpenVPN) for flexible remote access.- Performance Monitoring: Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitor Compute Engine health. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance.- Resource Management: Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene.- Cost Optimization: Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget.- Database Oversight: Provide support for PostgreSQL and Oracle environments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem.- Security & Compliance: Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeterRequired Qualifications- Certification: Active Google Cloud Professional DevOps Engineer certification.- Containerization Mastery: Strong expertise with Docker for containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes.- Scripting Mastery: High proficiency in Python or Bash for automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling.- Networking Expertise: Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs using pfSense and CloudConnexa.- Cloud Migration & Project Leadership: Proven experience leading and running application and data migrations from AWS to GCP. This includes the capability to own the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions.- Compute Engine Mastery: Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling.- English Proficiency: Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)Nice-to-Have- PostgreSQL Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning.- Oracle Expertise: Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments.- Data & Analytics: Familiarity with BigQuery.We offer- We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.- Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).- Personal laptop.- Health and wellness package.- Fully remote.As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

description:

- Projetar e implementarsistemas de agentes e multi-agentes, incluindo estruturas de supervisor, delegação de tarefas, memória e ferramentas;
- Desenvolver fluxos complexos utilizando LangChain e LangGraph, aplicando boas práticas de composição, controle e observabilidade;
- Integrar diferentes provedores de modelos (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, entre outros), escolhendo o melhor modelo para cada caso de uso;
- Atuar na definição deestratégias de engenharia de prompt, avaliação de respostas, mitigação de alucinações e controle de qualidade;
- Construir e evoluir pipelines de IA integrados a sistemas backend (APIs, filas, microsserviços);
- Participar ativamenteda inovação do produto através de POCs, MVPs e experimentos controlados;
- Definir padrões técnicos, boas práticas e ajudar a elevar o nível do time, atuando como referência técnica em IA.Requisitos e Qualificações:- Fundamentos sólidos de IA aplicada e LLMs;
- Engenharia de prompt (few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output, function calling);
- LangChain e seus principais conceitos (chains, tools, memory, retrievers);
- LangGraph para orquestração de fluxos e agentes complexos;
- Arquiteturas de agentes autônomos e multi-agentes, incluindo supervisor/worker;
- Integração com APIs deLLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, Claude);
- Design de APIs e serviços backend para consumo de IA;
- Observabilidade aplicada a IA (logs, métricas, tracing, avaliação de respostas);
- Conceitos de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), embeddings e vetorização;
- Mensageria, processamento assíncrono e arquiteturas distribuídas;
- Experiência prática colocando soluções de IA em produção;
- Mais de 5 anos de experiência em desenvolvimento de software, sendo parte disso com sistemas complexos ou distribuídos.Você vai se divertir mais se:- Tiver paixão por inteligência artificial e acompanhar a evolução rápida do ecossistema de LLMs;
- Gostar de resolver problemas ambíguos e ainda não totalmente definidos;
- Curte equilibrar experimentação rápida com engenharia robusta para produção;
- Tiver senso de dono ese preocupar com impacto real no usuário final.Será um diferencial se você:- Tiver experiência com Node.Js, Python ou TypeScript em sistemas de IA;
- Já tiver trabalhado com RAG em produção, FAISS, Pinecone, Weaviate ou similares;
- Conhecer técnicas de avaliação automática de LLMs (LLM-as-a-Judge, scoring, CSAT);
- Possuir experiência com AWS (EC2, S3, filas, escalabilidade);
- Ter participado da construção de produtos de IA para usuários finais;
- Já ter atuado como referência técnica ou líder técnico.Nossos benefícios:- Vale Alimentação/Refeição no cartão Flash;

Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínua DIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos. title: Cientista De Dados
description:
A missão do Cientista de Dados será atuar no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas para um produto de Analytics voltado a softwares de RH, contribuindo com a análise e modelagem de dados voltados à gestão de pessoas e processos. Fará parte de um time multidisciplinar responsável por criar modelos preditivos, gerar insights estratégicos e estruturar pipelines de dados eficientes. Também participará da implementação e treinamento de LLMs (Large Language Models) aplicados ao contexto de RH, apoiando a evolução do produto com foco em personalização e escalabilidade. O profissional terá um papel essencial na transformação de dados complexos em soluções inteligentes e aplicáveis ao negócio. O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER: Trabalhar em equipe no desenvolvimento de soluções analíticas aplicadas ao contexto de Recursos Humanos. Realizar exploração, tratamento e modelagem de dados para gerar insights estratégicos. Desenvolver modelos estatísticos e preditivos voltados à análise de comportamento, desempenho e gestão de pessoas. Atuar na implementação, ajuste fino e avaliação de desempenho de LLMs aplicados ao produto. Traduzir necessidades de negócio em soluções baseadas em dados. Contribuir com a documentação técnica e boas práticas de ciência de dados. Colaborar com times de produto, engenharia e UX para garantir integração fluida das soluções ao produto final. Participar de testes, validações e iterações de modelos em ambiente de produção. Acompanhar tendências e inovações na área de dados e inteligência artificial, especialmente em aplicações de RH. O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ: Graduação completa em Ciência de Dados, Estatística, Engenharia, Matemática, Computação ou áreas correlatas. Experiência prática com modelagem estatística, machine learning e análise exploratória de dados. Domínio de linguagens como Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy, etc.) e SQL. Conhecimento em conceitos e aplicações de LLMs (Large Language Models). Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas. Boa comunicação e habilidade para trabalhar em equipe multidisciplinar. SERIA LEGAL SE TIVESSE: Experiência prévia com dados de RH ou People Analytics. Conhecimento de ferramentas de visualização (ex: Metabase, Power BI, Tableau, Dash, etc.). Experiência com deployment de modelos em ambiente de produção. Pós-graduação ou cursos especializados em Ciência de Dados ou IA.
