title: Brazil Senior Condition Intelligence (Ci & Pm)
description:
Company DescriptionDingo Software is the global leader in predictive maintenance software for the mining industry, serving some of the world’s largest mining companies. We are best known for Driving efficiency, longevity and reliability for machines that matter. With 30+ years of asset health data, we're scaling rapidly under Riverside Company ownership to capture significant market opportunities.Following recent investment from The Riverside Company, Dingo is executing an ambitious growth strategy. We're building world-class commercial capabilities to support this growth journey.Role DescriptionAs a Condition Intelligence (CI) Specialist at Dingo, you will be at the heart of delivering data-driven insights that help our clients across the Americas protect their most critical assets. Your mission is to transform fluid, sensor, and digital inspection data into clear, actionable recommendations that prevent mobile and fixed-plant breakdowns, extend component life, and eliminate unplanned downtime.In this pivotal role, you will collaborate closely within then Dingo Technical Services team to monitor asset health remotely, assess component-level risk, and guide operational decisions that directly impact productivity, safety, and cost efficiency. You will be instrumental in harnessing Dingo’s advanced analytics and AI-driven capabilities to proactively engage client to identify risks before they escalate, ensuring consistently measurable results.With a primary focus on our rapidly growing North and South American customer base, you will combine technical expertise with strong communication skills to deliver timely, trusted advice, strengthening long-term partnerships. In a mining sector increasingly focused on efficiency, sustainability, and predictive maintenance, your work will be a key driver in cementing Dingo’s reputation as the leader in asset health intelligence.Condition Data Analysis & Diagnostics – Review and interpret condition management data from both mobile and fixed plant assets to diagnose component-level risks. Apply domain expertise to determine root causes, assess severity, and prioritize corrective actions based on operational impact, safety, and mission criticality.Rules-Based Analytics Development – Create and refine rules-based analytics to enable swift detection of emerging issues. Ensure diagnostic models and alert parameters support early intervention, reducing downtime and extending component life.Technical Support & Collaboration – Provide expert guidance to Dingo teams on component health assessments, lubrication strategies, and condition management best practices. Act as a trusted technical resource for troubleshooting and advanced diagnostics.Customer Communication & Maintenance Recommendations – Follow up on flagged components or lubricant issues, translating complex technical data into clear, actionable maintenance recommendations for customers. Ensure communications are timely, accurate, and aligned with customer priorities.Quality Observation Reviews – Deliver high-quality, daily observation reviews and actionable insights, consistently applying safety-first principles and considering operational mission criticality.Data Accuracy & System Integrity – Monitor the condition management software database to ensure data accuracy, resolve discrepancies, and maintain the integrity of condition records.Lubricated Component Health Assessment – Evaluate the condition of lubricated components to identify opportunities for extending asset life through on-condition maintenance changes.Customer Engagement & Follow-Up – Organize and lead remote Condition Management follow-up meetings with customers and internal teams to confirm satisfaction, address concerns, and reinforce positive engagement experiences.Diagnostic Tools & Guideline Development – Assist in developing structured diagnostic guidelines, contamination troubleshooting processes, and detailed repair procedures to support consistent, high-quality component health management.QualificationsExperience – Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in heavy industrial equipment maintenance within industrial or mining environments;
OR a Mechanical or Mining Engineering degree with at least two (2) years of relevant experience. Hands-on background as a shop or field mechanic for industrial mining equipment is highly desirable.Industry Knowledge – Strong familiarity with mining and industrial maintenance principles, including mechanical systems, equipment design, and repair processes.Lubrication & Condition Monitoring Expertise – In-depth understanding of lubrication applications, maintenance principles, familiarity in onboard machine telemetry and/or OEM condition monitoring reporting systems, and the use of condition monitoring technologies and tools to inform proactive maintenance strategies.Technical Proficiency – Proven ability to use data and factual analysis to troubleshoot issues, solve problems, and make informed operational decisions.Linguistic Proficiency – Fluency in English is essential for clear and effective communication with customers and internal teams. A high degree of proficiency in Spanish or French is a strong advantage for engaging with a broader range of stakeholders.Communication & Leadership – Excellent verbal and written communication skills, coupled with strong information management capabilities. Demonstrated ability to lead interactions with both internal teams and external customers, building trust and alignment.

Here's What Makes Us Different: Proven Growth Track Record : We've 3x'd our business while maintaining quality - our clients' content actually generates leads and builds brands ⚡ Small Team = Massive Growth Potential : Work directly with the founder, acquire skills rapidly, and shape the trajectory of a fast-scaling agency Real Impact, Real Results : The calls you book directly fuel our growth and put you at the center of every new client we sign. Your Mission (Should You Choose to Accept It): You'll own the top of our sales pipeline - turning LinkedIn conversations and inbound leads into booked calls on Braden's calendar. This isn't about spray-and-pray outreach or copy-paste scripts. You'll build real conversations with B2B founders and marketers, qualify them fast, and hand off warm, ready-to-buy prospects. Every call you book is a shot at a high paying client for GP Socials. The Role: B2B Appointment Setter Core Responsibilities: 1. LinkedIn Outbound & Conversation Management Run daily LinkedIn outreach to qualified B2B founders, marketers, and decision-makers Use AI to personalize opening messages based on the prospect's content, company, and role (no generic blasts) Manage 50-100+ active LinkedIn conversations at a time without dropping threads Handle objections in DMs and move qualified prospects toward a booked call Track every conversation in our CRM with clear status, notes, and next steps 2. Inbound Lead Follow-Up Respond to inbound leads from our content, referrals, and marketing FAST Qualify leads against our ICP (B2B businesses doing $1M-$10M in revenue) Book discovery calls directly onto Braden's calendar Send pre-call confirmations and reduce no-show rates with reminder sequences 3. Pipeline Hygiene & Reporting Keep the CRM clean: accurate stages, follow-up tasks, and conversation history Report daily on outreach sent, replies, booked calls, and show rates Flag patterns in objections and reply data so we can sharpen our messaging Follow written SOPs for outreach cadences, qualification, and handoff Who You Are: Non-Negotiables & Must-Haves Deal-Makers (You Need ALL of These): ✅ B2B Agency or SaaS Setting Experience: I do not care about years worked. All I care about is if you have booked calls with B2B businesses ✅ Writes Like a Human: You can write DMs that sound like a real person, not a bot. You understand tone, pacing, and how to earn a reply in 2-3 sentences. ✅ Fluent Written English: Your written English is clean enough that founders in the US won't clock you as a non-native speaker over DM. (Spoken English is a plus, but writing is the non-negotiable.)✅ CRM Discipline: You don't forget follow-ups, you don't lose threads, and you can be trusted to keep the pipeline clean without reminders. I should be able to look in the CRM and understand everything ✅ Availability: Available to work EST business hours (9am-5pm EST) Monday-Friday for real-time collaboration and inbound response. Deal-Breakers (Any of These = Not a Fit): ❌ No proven B2B setting experience ❌ Rely on copy-paste templates and mass-blast tactics ❌ Written English that reads as broken, stiff, or obviously AI-generated ❌ Can't show specific numbers (calls booked, show rate, deals closed-won) from a previous setting role ❌ Unwilling to work EST hours or live inside a CRM all day ❌ Looking for a passive role You're Perfect If You: Get fired up about finding the exact line that makes a cold prospect say "yeah, let's talk" Think in reply rates, show rates, and close rates - not just messages sent Treat DMs like a craft, not a grind Have run setting for a B2B agency or SaaS before and can talk about what worked and what flopped The Package: What's In It for You Compensation: Base: $1,500 USD/month Performance Bonus: $50 USD per booked call that shows up to the discovery call Our Target: 20+ booked calls per month (realistic earnings $2,500+/month, uncapped) The more calls you book, the more we make and the more you make. No ceiling. The Perks: Fully remote - work from anywhere in LATAM with a laptop and stable internet ⚡ Work directly with the founder - no sales manager layers, no bureaucracy Rapid skill acquisition - you'll learn B2B sales, positioning, and pipeline management from the inside of a scaling agency Shape our growth - you're the first setter we're hiring. The playbook you help build is the playbook we'll scale. Great to leverage your experience in future endeavors The Real Benefits: Book calls for an agency that actually closes them - you won't be stuck in a pipeline where good leads go to die Work inbound + outbound - you're not just cold-DMing strangers, you're also converting warm leads from real content Your work has a direct line to revenue - every call you book is tracked, and every client signed came from a call on the calendar Join a company that tripled revenue in a year and is building the most reliable content growth partner for B2B businesses Our Values: The DNA of GP Socials ⚡ Speed - Speed creates room for unavoidable errors. We move fast, test quickly, and iterate relentlessly. Ownership - Everyone makes mistakes, but we'll go further when we own them and learn from them. No excuses, just solutions. Grit - The more hits you can take, the more unstoppable you become. We embrace challenges as opportunities to prove what we're made of. Excellence - Good isn't good enough. We're building the best content growth partner for B2B businesses, and that requires excellence in everything we do. The Process: Fast, Transparent, Respectful Apply with resume + 3-minute Loom video (details below) Setting Work Sample - Complete a real outreach + qualification task for an actual scenario Deep Dive with Braden - Expectations discussion, portfolio review, and your questions answered Offer within 5 business days of final interview Here's How to Stand Out: Apply Here: ( Include: Your resume/LinkedIn and any proof of past setting results (booked call numbers, show rates, closed deals you contributed to, screenshots of pipeline dashboards, etc. ) A 3-minute Loom video covering: Your biggest setting win (specific numbers: calls booked per month, show rate, deals closed - the more specific, the better) Why GP Socials specifically (not just "I need a job") The core value from above that resonates most with you and why Optional but impressive: A short case study showing a specific setting campaign you ran - what the ICP was, what your opening DM looked like, and what the results were The Work Sample (What to Expect in Round 2): If you advance, we'll send you a short work sample that mirrors the actual job You will deliver: An opening LinkedIn DM (your exact words, as you'd send it) A 3-message follow-up sequence How you'd respond to 2-3 common objections A brief explanation of your reasoning This shows us: Can you actually write? Do you understand B2B positioning? Can you handle objections without getting stiff or defensive? PS - A Personal Note from Braden Ricchini, Founder The sad truth is that most agencies treat setters like number-hitters. Send 200 DMs a day, copy-paste the templates, book whatever lands on the calendar, move on. But I'm looking for someone who gets obsessed with the craft. Someone who studies the DMs that worked and asks "what exactly made this one convert?" Someone who can tell the difference between a lead that'll close and a lead that'll waste my hour. Someone who cares about show rates, not just book rates. Basically, I'm looking for people who are hungry. If you're the kind of person who geeks out over sales psychology, who tracks their own reply rates obsessively, who genuinely cares whether the calls you book turn into clients or just fill the calendar, then we should definitely connect. We're small, we're scaling fast, and you'll have a front-row seat to building a B2B sales system from scratch. No fluff, no fake promises. — Braden PPS: Still reading? title: Ai Enablement Engineer / Ai Platform Engineer
description:
About Turing: Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents;
and second, by applyingthat expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L Job Overview: We are looking for experienced engineers with deep design expertise to create challenging, simulation-based design problems for training and evaluating advanced AI models. The role focuses on crafting realistic engineering design tasks where a model must make genuine trade-offs, size components, and iterate against physics-based simulators to meet competing specifications. Key Responsibilities: Design and validate simulation-based engineering problems that require true design reasoning, with clear constraints and optimization goals. Deliver complete problem sets including reference solutions, near-miss variants, edge cases, and documentation, ensure appropriate difficulty with multiple failure modes, and collaborate with researchers to refine problems based on model performance. Domain Tracks: You should have deep design expertise in at least one of the followin g;
expertise spanning multiple tracks is a strong plus. Electrical & Computer Engineering — analog/mixed-signal IC design, power electronics, RF/microwave, digital system design, FPGA/ASIC, embedded systems. Mechanical Engineering — structural/thermal/fluid system design, mechanism design, HVAC, vibration/dynamics, manufacturing process design. Chemical Engineering — reactor design, process design and optimization, separation systems, transport phenomena, combustion and thermochemistry. Control Systems — classical and modern control design, state estimation, nonlinear and robust control, system identification. Materials / Nano — materials selection under constraints, microstructure-property design, thin-film and nanoscale device design. Engineering Physics / Optics — optical system design, photonic device design, laser systems, wave propagation and interference. Aerospace Engineering — aerodynamic design, propulsion sizing, orbital mechanics, flight dynamics and stability, structural design for aerospace loads. Civil / Structural Engineering — structural member and connection design, foundation design, seismic/wind loading, geotechnical design. Nuclear / Energy — reactor core design, shielding, thermal-hydraulics, renewable energy system sizing, grid-scale storage design. Systems Engineering — system architecture trade studies, requirements decomposition, interface design, multi-subsystem integration. Robotics — kinematic/dynamic design, motion planning, actuator and sensor selection, mechatronic system integration. Required Qualifications: Master’s or PhD in a relevant engineering/applied science field. 3+ years of hands-on engineering design experience, producing validated designs from competing specs (not just analysis). Proficient in at least one open-source simulation tool relevant to the domain. Strong Python (or equivalent) scripting skills. High attention to detail across units, boundary conditions, convergence, and physical realism. Offer Details: Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST. Engagement type: Contractor Evaluation Process: Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form. After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours. Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to discuss the pre‑onboarding requirements. After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile. Know amazing talent? Refer /referrals, and earn money from your network.

Suas principais funções incluem investigar o perfil do lead, realizar o primeiro contato (e-mail, telefone, LinkedIn) e agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendasAS PRINCIPAIS FUNÇÕESProspecção Ativa (Outbound): Identificar potenciais clientes (leads) que se encaixam no perfil ideal (ICP), buscando decisores e gerando novas listas.Qualificação de Leads (Inbound/Outbound): Analisar se o lead tem o problema que a empresa resolve, poder de decisão e verba, separando os qualificados (SQLs) dos curiosos.Primeiro Contato e Engajamento: Realizar abordagens via WhatsApp, e-mail, ligações (cold calls) e redes sociais, utilizando fluxos de cadência para despertar interesse.Agendamento de Reuniões: Agendar conversas entre o lead qualificado (SQLs) e os Executivos de Vendas (Closers).Gestão de CRM: Registrar e atualizar todas as interações e informações sobre o lead no sistema de CRM.Follow-up (Acompanhamento): Realizar contatos contínuos para manter o engajamento de leads que não estão no momento exato de compra.REQUISITOS E HABILIDADESResiliência e Mentalidade (Mindset): Capacidade de lidar com rejeições diárias (\ "nãos\") sem perder a motivação.Escuta Ativa: Capacidade de ouvir mais do que falar, identificando\ "dores\" e nuances nas conversas com o cliente.Conhecimento do ICP: Entender profundamente quem é o cliente ideal da empresa para filtrar e focar nos leads certos.Personalização de Abordagem: Evitar scripts robóticos;
adaptar a conversa paracada lead de forma criativa e personalizada.Organização e Disciplina: Manter rotina de atividades de alta demanda, boa gestão do CRM e uso correto da cadência de prospecção.Solução de Problemas: Agilidade mental para conectar as necessidades do lead às soluções da empresa.Curiosidade e Aprendizado Constante: Buscar conhecimento sobre o mercado, técnicas de vendas e o produto/serviço vendido.Comunicação Persuasiva: Saber conduzir a conversa e contornar objeções com firmeza e inteligência.Diferencial:Experiência prévia como SDR jurídico.REMUNERAÇÃOModelo híbrido: Ajuda de custo fixa nos três primeiros meses R$ 2.000,00 (dois mil reais), após o quarto mês R$ 2.500,00 (dois mil e quinhentos reais) + Variável por atingimento de metas;
Comissão vinculada a reuniões agendadas com leads qualificados, contratos fechados e avaliação de atendimento;
Comissão agressiva por indicação de leads externos as campanhas de Tráfego pago;
Possibilidade real de crescimento financeiro e profissional.MODELO DE TRABALHOTipo de Contrato: PJPRESENCIAL NO RECIFE (BOA VIAGEM) - Inegociável!Estrutura de SDR, playbook comercial e metas claras.Importante:1. Se os R$ 2.000,00 de ajuda de custo te parecem suficientes, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você!2. O valor fixo é esse — o diferencial está na comissão e nos prêmios por desempenho.3. Agora, se você precisa ir além, busca resultados, resolve problemas, não tem medo de prospectar e qualificar clientes e carrega mais boletos do que dias no mês, então essa oportunidade é para você.Candidate-se!

Não buscamos pessoas prontas;
não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico: da mão no código à tomada de decisão. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:- O Agora (Execução e Precisão):- Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.- Garantir precisão absoluta /"batendo/" dados e regras manualmente;
em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.- Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.- O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):- Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais.- Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.- Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios, utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.O QUE BUSCAMOS:- Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.- Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.- Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).- Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).O QUE OFERECEMOS- Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.- Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.- Equipe de alto nível: você encontrará pessoas fora da curva e nada melhor do que trabalhar com pessoas assim, né?- Flexibilidade e Futuro: Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária (Equity) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.- Legado: você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

Estamos em plena expansão, com operações reais, clientes ativos e novos parceiros no pipeline. não saber tudo faz parte do processo. O que valorizamos é a curiosidade investigativa e o desejo genuíno de aprender.Você atuará do operacional ao estratégico: da mão no código à tomada de decisão. É o perfil que propõe novos modelos e identifica oportunidades de receita, mas que também valida dados manualmente para garantir que a solução seja impecável. Atitude, velocidade e senso de urgência são os motores que impulsionam nossa entrega.PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES:Sua missão é liderar a transição tecnológica da nossa inteligência:- O Agora (Execução e Precisão):- Refinar e otimizar modelos em produção (AWS Bedrock), elevando constantemente os níveis de acurácia e performance.- Garantir precisão absoluta /"batendo/" dados e regras manualmente;
em saúde, a qualidade do dado é inegociável.- Monitorar padrões de negativas (denials) e implementar loops de correção imediatos para que o sistema aprenda em tempo real.- O Futuro (Escala e Arquitetura):- Evoluir nossa infraestrutura para um ecossistema robusto de RAGs e bancos vetoriais.- Migrar de uma solução centralizada para uma malha de modelos especializados por contexto e seguradora.- Contribuir para o fine-tuning de modelos próprios, utilizando nossos dados históricos para criar uma vantagem competitiva única.O QUE BUSCAMOS:- Curiosidade Investigativa: Desejo genuíno de aprender e decifrar as regras complexas do faturamento médico. Você não precisa vir da saúde, mas precisa querer dominá-la.- Atitude e Senso de Urgência: Valorizamos a velocidade e a proatividade. Em nosso contexto de negócio, a capacidade de entrega rápida é vital.- Mão no Código: Experiência prática sólida com Python ou Go e APIs de LLM (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock).- Mentalidade de Builder: Capacidade de construir sistemas robustos do zero e obsessão pelo detalhe (não descansa enquanto a automação não reflete a regra de negócio com precisão cirúrgica).O QUE OFERECEMOS- Oportunidade em Estágio Inicial: Chance de ser um dos primeiros membros de uma empresa em rápida expansão, com impacto direto na arquitetura e cultura.- Desafio Técnico de Alto Nível: Resolver problemas reais usando o estado da arte em IA Generativa.- Equipe de alto nível: você encontrará pessoas fora da curva e nada melhor do que trabalhar com pessoas assim, né?- Flexibilidade e Futuro: Trabalho 100% remoto com possibilidade de participação societária (Equity) para quem constrói o negócio conosco.- Legado: você deixará o seu nome na construção, nos códigos e na história da empresa.

title: Creative Strategist

With a team of over 75 professionals, we deliver best-in-class paid media, email marketing, and creative services to help brands scale profitably. We work across the entire customer lifecycle: from content creation and paid advertising to conversion rate optimization and retention marketing. Our partnership-first approach has earned us a 90% client retention rate and recognition as an Inc. 5000 honoree for three consecutive years (2023, 2024, 2025). We are proud to be a Klaviyo Master Elite Agency, a distinction held by only 0.2% of Klaviyo's 6,500+ partners. To date, we have driven billions of dollars in attributed revenue for our partners. The Role Lilo Social is seeking a Creative Strategist to lead performance-driven creative strategy across a portfolio of direct-to-consumer brands. You will own the end-to-end creative testing engine—from research and messaging frameworks to briefs, storyboards, conversion rate optimization ideas, and ongoing iteration—helping clients consistently find creative winners and scale spend profitably. This is a highly cross-functional role where you will partner closely with design, video, media buying, and account teams while working directly with clients to set creative direction, align on priorities, and build repeatable roadmaps for growth. What Success Looks Like A clear, repeatable creative testing system running across your client portfolio with consistent velocity to new concepts, angles, and iterations Creative insights that translate into measurable performance improvements including higher click-through rates, conversion rates, lower customer acquisition costs, and scalable winning campaigns Strong client trust in your strategic point of view, demonstrated through proactive communication, data-backed recommendations, and leadership in creative direction Elevated internal creative standards through contributions to team training, standard operating procedures, and systems that improve output quality and speed Responsibilities Lead research and insights by mining customer reviews, competitor ads libraries, audience pain points, and product differentiators to identify winning angles and positioning strategies Own creative testing strategy by building and managing structured testing roadmaps with clear hypotheses, variables to test, iteration plans, and learning agendas Create world-class creative briefs that transform insights into crisp, actionable direction for designers and video editors including hooks, messaging frameworks, visual concepts, format specifications, and success criteria Direct performance storytelling by mapping the customer journey from awareness through consideration to purchase and translating it into compelling paid social concepts Build UGC and production guidance including shot lists, video scripts, creator direction, and content planning that supports performance-oriented execution Manage creator relationships by sourcing, coordinating, and guiding content creators to produce on-brief, performance-oriented content that aligns with testing objectives Write high-performing ad copy including primary text, headlines, hooks, and on-screen text that aligns with strategic goals and testing frameworks Collaborate on conversion rate optimization by partnering with teams on landing page improvements and conversion-focused messaging updates Track and communicate performance by monitoring key performance indicators by concept and angle, synthesizing learnings, and reporting insights to internal teams and clients Develop inspiration and competitor boards to inform creative direction and identify market trends and opportunities Lead copy across paid ads for in-ad copy and headline variations that drive engagement and conversions Requirements 1-2 years of experience in ecommerce or performance marketing with strong preference for direct-to-consumer brand experience Proven track record of paid social creative strategy with expertise in Meta Ads (required) and familiarity with TikTok or YouTube (preferred) Strong grasp of creative testing methodology including hypothesis development, structured testing frameworks, iteration velocity, and performance analysis Experience working with design and video teams from brief development through execution to iteration, with ability to provide clear, actionable creative direction Data-fluent approach with comfort using performance metrics including click-through rates, conversion rates, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend to make decisions and guide priorities Deep understanding of customer psychology, marketing funnels, and storytelling principles that drive direct response performance Excellent copywriting skills across multiple formats including hooks, scripts, ad copy, and landing pages with proven ability to write persuasive, conversion-focused content Highly organized with strong attention to detail, quality control processes, and ability to manage multiple clients and deadlines simultaneously Proficiency with Meta Ads Manager, Shopify, Google Analytics, Figma, Motion, and collaboration tools including Slack, Asana, or Notion Nice to Have Client-facing experience including presenting strategy, leading client calls, and confidently pushing for action based on data and creative insights Experience with conversion rate optimization and landing page testing frameworks to improve post-click performance Experience building creative playbooks, training materials, or onboarding systems for creative teams Familiarity with additional paid social platforms including TikTok Ads, YouTube Ads, or Pinterest Ads Background in agency environments managing multiple client accounts with varying needs and timelines Compensation and Benefits Time Off : Competitive PTO policy and paid holidays to maintain work-life balance Fully Remote title: Senior Buyer
description:
Senior Buyer (Indirect Procurement) A global organization is hiring a Senior Buyer to join its Indirect Category team. This role supports a wide range of indirect spend categories (e.G., travel, corporate services, facilities, IT services, training, uniforms/workwear, and other business services), partnering closely with internal stakeholders and suppliers to deliver an efficient end-to-end purchasing experience. The ideal candidate is a highly organized, detail-oriented team player who will oversee the entire order process. What you’ll do: Manage day-to-day purchasing for assigned countries via a PO/requisition system, including processing requisitions in Workday. Source suppliers, obtain quotes, negotiate, and ensure preferred suppliers are used. Maintain supplier catalogs for repetitive purchases and manage open orders to ensure timely delivery/receiving in the system. Build procurement reports/dashboards and partner with accounts payable to resolve invoice issues. Lead local sourcing projects and negotiate contracts. You will review proposals, negotiate prices, select the best suppliers, analyze trends, follow up with placed orders, verify delivery, approve payment, and maintain necessary records. Perform commercial analysis on suppliers to develop more efficient processes and cost-effective solutions Qualifications: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in purchasing, inventory, or supply chain management Excellent written and verbal communication skills 5+ years in Procurement / Buying / Supply Chain;
Strong stakeholder management, ethics, and reporting skills Advanced Excel/PowerPoint/Word. Comfortable in a fast-changing environment;
international travel may be required. Proficiency in English is mandatory for this position. Interested? Apply with your CV and a brief summary of your indirect procurement experience (categories, systems, especially Workday, and typical contract values). Company details shared with shortlisted candidates only.

Criar e otimizar APIs RESTful e serviços com Node.Js e frameworks como Fastify, Express, NestJS e Koa.Js. Integrar sistemas internos e externos (ERPs, adquirentes, gateways de pagamento). Modelar e gerenciar bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais ( MySQL, MongoDB, Redis ). Implementar pipelines de CI/CD em BitBucket e GitLab. Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter: Experiência comprovada em JavaScript/TypeScript. Conhecimento avançado em React e Node.Js. Vivência com frameworks back-end ( Fastify, Express, NestJS, Koa.Js ). Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais ( MySQL, MongoDB, Redis ). Familiaridade com práticas de CI/CD e ferramentas como BitBucket/GitLab. Experiência com AWS e seus principais serviços. Domínio de Git para versionamento e colaboração. Diferenciais técnicos: Experiência em arquiteturas serverless. Vivência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade. Vivência com integrações com sistemas externos (ex: adquirentes, ERPs, gateways de pagamento) Conhecimento de estratégias de segurança e observabilidade em APIs REST (rate limiting, circuit breaker, tracing, etc.) Participação em projetos com alto volume transacional e requisitos de alta disponibilidade Stack e Ferramentas Linguagem: JavaScript (ES6+) / TypeScript Front-end: React (SPA, Hooks, Context API, boas práticas de componentização) Runtime: Node.Js Frameworks: Fastfy, Express, NestJS, Koa.Js Banco de dados: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis CI/CD: BitBucket, GitLab Infraestrutura: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, etc.) Monitoramento: CloudWatch, etc. Versionamento: Git Boas Práticas: Clean Code, SOLID, testes automatizados, integração contínua e cultura DevOps O que oferecemos Atuação em produtos críticos com desafios reais de performance e escalabilidade Ambiente técnico colaborativo e com autonomia para decisões arquiteturais Flexibilidade de trabalho remoto ou híbrido Acesso a produtos reais com grande volume de transações Mais informações: Possuir CNPJ ativo (nosso modelo de contratação é PJ - Prestador de Serviço);
Vagas remota e com horários flexíveis;
Temos 2 vagas(uma nível PL e outra SR). Acha que é essa vaga é pra você? Não perca tempo e venha fazer parte da revolução do varejo com a gente! #vemsereyemaker! title: Pré-Vendas
description:
VAGA: SDR (Sales Development Representative ou Representante de Desenvolvimento de Vendas)Estamos em busca de SDR para atuar em escritório especializado em dívidas bancárias e reestruturação financeira, com foco em qualificação de leads, Prospecção Ativa, Qualificação Receptiva (Inbound), Gestão de Cadência e Alimentação do CRM..PRINCIPAL RESPONSABILIDADEO SDR é um pré-vendedor focado na primeira etapa do funil: pesquisar, prospectar e qualificar leads, transformando-os em oportunidades. Suas principais funções incluem investigar o perfil do lead, realizar o primeiro contato (e-mail, telefone, LinkedIn) e agendar reuniões qualificadas para o time de vendasAS PRINCIPAIS FUNÇÕESProspecção Ativa (Outbound): Identificar potenciais clientes (leads) que se encaixam no perfil ideal (ICP), buscando decisores e gerando novas listas.Qualificação de Leads (Inbound/Outbound): Analisar se o lead tem o problema que a empresa resolve, poder de decisão e verba, separando os qualificados (SQLs) dos curiosos.Primeiro Contato e Engajamento: Realizar abordagens via WhatsApp, e-mail, ligações (cold calls) e redes sociais, utilizando fluxos de cadência para despertar interesse.Agendamento de Reuniões: Agendar conversas entre o lead qualificado (SQLs) e os Executivos de Vendas (Closers).Gestão de CRM: Registrar e atualizar todas as interações e informações sobre o lead no sistema de CRM.Follow-up (Acompanhamento): Realizar contatos contínuos para manter o engajamento de leads que não estão no momento exato de compra.REQUISITOS E HABILIDADESResiliência e Mentalidade (Mindset): Capacidade de lidar com rejeições diárias (\ "nãos\") sem perder a motivação.Escuta Ativa: Capacidade de ouvir mais do que falar, identificando\ "dores\" e nuances nas conversas com o cliente.Conhecimento do ICP: Entender profundamente quem é o cliente ideal da empresa para filtrar e focar nos leads certos.Personalização de Abordagem: Evitar scripts robóticos;
adaptar a conversa paracada lead de forma criativa e personalizada.Organização e Disciplina: Manter rotina de atividades de alta demanda, boa gestão do CRM e uso correto da cadência de prospecção.Solução de Problemas: Agilidade mental para conectar as necessidades do lead às soluções da empresa.Curiosidade e Aprendizado Constante: Buscar conhecimento sobre o mercado, técnicas de vendas e o produto/serviço vendido.Comunicação Persuasiva: Saber conduzir a conversa e contornar objeções com firmeza e inteligência.Diferencial:Experiência prévia como SDR jurídico.REMUNERAÇÃOModelo híbrido: Ajuda de custo fixa nos três primeiros meses R$ 2.000,00 (dois mil reais), após o quarto mês R$ 2.500,00 (dois mil e quinhentos reais) + Variável por atingimento de metas;
Comissão vinculada a reuniões agendadas com leads qualificados, contratos fechados e avaliação de atendimento;
Comissão agressiva por indicação de leads externos as campanhas de Tráfego pago;
Possibilidade real de crescimento financeiro e profissional.MODELO DE TRABALHOTipo de Contrato: PJPRESENCIAL NO RECIFE (BOA VIAGEM) - Inegociável!Estrutura de SDR, playbook comercial e metas claras.Importante:1. Se os R$ 2.000,00 de ajuda de custo te parecem suficientes, essa vaga provavelmente não é para você!2. O valor fixo é esse — o diferencial está na comissão e nos prêmios por desempenho.3. Agora, se você precisa ir além, busca resultados, resolve problemas, não tem medo de prospectar e qualificar clientes e carrega mais boletos do que dias no mês, então essa oportunidade é para você.Candidate-se!

title: Analista Financeiro Ii (Financial Analyst)
description:
Company DescriptionUpstream Capital is a tactical investor focused on growth-stage technology companies, deploying both debt and equity to scale businesses. Headquartered in São Paulo, Brazil, the firm has a global reach, with a proven track record of investing over $200 million in over 25 tech companies across Latin America, the Bay Area, and other regions. With deep expertise in the tech sector, Upstream Capital operates as a comprehensive finance platform leveraging knowledge, networking, data, and AI to drive success. The company is committed to partnering with innovative businesses, finding creative solutions to complex challenges, and aligning success between investors and investees for long-term growth.Role DescriptionThe role is designed for someone who is deeply curious about how companies operate, how their economics work, and what are the patterns that makes some of them thrive. The Intern will be exposed to the full investment process and encouraged to think critically about markets and capital allocation.Beyond analytical work, we value people who enjoy engaging with the broader investment landscape. The role involves listening, asking good questions, forming independent views, and contributing ideas to internal discussions. Curiosity and judgment matter as much as technical skills.Upstream operates in a lean, high-ownership environment. Interns are expected to take responsibility for their work, explore opportunities proactively, and learn by doing. We look for individuals who are comfortable navigating ambiguity and who see feedback and mistakes as part of the learning process.Candidates may come from any academic background. What matters is intellectual rigor, attention to detail, and a consistent pattern of high personal standards. Prior exposure to finance, consulting, or technology is a plus, but not a prerequisite.QualificationsProficiency in Financial Modeling and deep understanding of Finance principlesAbility to communicate insights effectively through reports and presentationsExperience in, or knowledge of, the technology sector is a plusFluency in English;
proficiency in Portuguese and/or Spanish is strongly preferredBachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, or a related fieldAbout UsFormerly known as Upload Ventures Growth, Upstream has the goal of becoming a platform for lifecycle investing in growth and late-stage technology companies. The firm builds on Upload’s track record of supporting global founders and leverages its experience in venture capital, technology, and data to identify, underwrite, and scale high-performing businesses.Upstream operates with a lean structure and a hands-on approach. We value analytical rigor, operational discipline, and the ability to execute with precision in fast-paced environments.
